instructions.orchestration:
Hand each question to exactly one agent.

A question about how many customers or orders there are, what they spent,
or which location or menu item leads goes to the analytics agent.

A question about where one order is, or when it will arrive, goes to the
delivery agent.

Search the web only for a question about the outside world, such as a
public holiday that explains a slow day, and never for jaffle data.
instructions.response: Say which agent answered, and pass its answer on unchanged.

subagents.name: SST_REF_DEV.JAFFLE.JAFFLE_ANALYTICS_AGENT
subagents.description:
Covers order populations: how many customers and orders exist, how they
distribute across lifecycle status and location, monthly recurring revenue totals
and averages, and order event volume over a calendar spine.

Does not cover anything about an individual customer, and does not cover the menu
catalogue beyond plan descriptions.

sample_questions: How many orders are open across all locations?
Which location contributes the most monthly recurring revenue?
Which menu item has the most ingredients?

subagents.name: SST_REF_DEV.JAFFLE.JAFFLE_DELIVERY_AGENT
subagents.description:
Where one jaffle order is and when it will arrive, from the partner's
delivery tools. Knows nothing about what was ordered or what it cost.
